paras: Hypsilurus bruijnii, also known commonly as the Bruijn forest dragon, the Bruijni forest dragon, and Bruijn's forest dragon, is a species of lizard in the family Agamidae. The species is native to Indonesia and Papua New Guinea.
The specific name, bruijnii, is in honor of Dutch naturalist Anton August Bruijn.
The natural habitat of H. bruijnii is rainforest.
Medium-sized for its genus, H. bruijnii may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 13 cm (5.1 in), with a tail length of 45 cm (18 in).
